{
  "test_name": "LedgerIssue2129",
  "test_code": "using System.IO;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing FluentAssertions;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\nusing MessagePack.SourceGenerator;\n\npublic class LedgerIssue2129\n{\n    private readonly ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper;\n\n    public LedgerIssue2129(ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper)\n    {\n        this.testOutputHelper = testOutputHelper;\n    }\n\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task ExternalTypeFormatter_WithSurrogateType_GeneratesFormatter()\n    {\n        var net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n\n        string projectASource = \"\"\"\nnamespace ProjectA\n{\n    public class ExternalType\n    {\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        CSharpCompilation projectACompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ProjectA\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(projectASource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            net80Refs,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        using var projectAStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var projectAEmitResult = projectACompilation.Emit(projectAStream);\n        projectAEmitResult.Success.Should().BeTrue();\n        projectAStream.Position = 0;\n        var projectARef = MetadataReference.CreateFromStream(projectAStream);\n\n        string projectBSource = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\nusing MessagePack.Formatters;\nusing ProjectA;\n\nnamespace ProjectB\n{\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class ExternalTypeSurrogate\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;\n    }\n\n    [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter(SurrogateType = typeof(ExternalTypeSurrogate))]\n    public partial class ExternalTypeFormatter : IMessagePackFormatter<ExternalType>\n    {\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        var projectBReferences = net80Refs\n            .Concat(ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack))\n            .Append(projectARef);\n\n        CSharpCompilation projectBCompilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"ProjectB\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(projectBSource, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            projectBReferences,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(projectBCompilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error).Should().BeEmpty();\n\n        var generatedSource = runResult.GeneratedSources\n            .FirstOrDefault(s => s.SourceText.ToString().Contains(\"ExternalTypeFormatter\"));\n        generatedSource.Should().NotBeNull(\"source generator should produce a partial class implementation for ExternalTypeFormatter\");\n\n        var sourceCode = generatedSource.SourceText.ToString();\n        sourceCode.Should().Contain(\"Serialize\");\n        sourceCode.Should().Contain(\"Deserialize\");\n\n        var compilationErrors = outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics()\n            .Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error)\n            .ToList();\n        compilationErrors.Should().BeEmpty(\"output compilation should have no errors after generator runs\");\n\n        using var projectBStream = new MemoryStream();\n        var emitResult = outputCompilation.Emit(projectBStream);\n        emitResult.Success.Should().BeTrue(\"output compilation should emit successfully\");\n    }\n}"
}
